neighbours.label: Evaluating how well a model or hypothesis fits the evidence in scientific argument (modified to allow for, which model best fits, makes sense in light of the evidence), vs the same verbs in everyday choices
fire: Theorists adjusted the inflation model to allow for the faint signal seen by the telescope.
The team ran several simulations of the galaxy to see which one best matched the observed rotation.
An African origin for the population makes excellent sense in light of the genetic data.
Geologists revised the plate model to allow for the strange magnetic stripes on the seabed.
They tested four models of the epidemic to see which one best fit the reported cases.
A marine origin for the fossils makes good sense given the chemistry of the rock.
Astronomers extended the standard theory to allow for the unexpectedly fast expansion.
The authors compared two models of the ice sheet to see which one best fit the satellite record.
quiet: The organisers adjusted the seating plan to allow for the late arrival of the band.
The team tried several pizza places in town to see which one had the best crust.
A morning start for the hike makes excellent sense in light of the hot weather.
The builders revised the kitchen plan to allow for a larger fridge.
They tested four brands of coffee to see which one tasted the best.
A cheaper hotel for the trip makes good sense given our small budget.
The teacher extended the deadline to allow for the school holiday.
The couple compared two flats in the centre to see which one was quieter.

predictions: The function word or verb in a sentence weighing a model or theory against evidence reaches 0.2-0.4; the same frames about recipes, plans or purchases stay under 0.05.
short: explanatory fit of a scientific model
notes: Card: peaks on ' to' x7 (model modified to allow for), ' one' (which one best fit the observations), ' makes' (origin makes excellent sense), ' of' (only way out of these difficulties), ' helps' (helps explain). Logit effect of the + pole suppresses consistent/fit. Probe: model to allow for 0.284, which one best fit the data 0.302, makes good sense in light of evidence 0.253; 'helps explain' 0.079, 'hard to account for' 0.017; recipe to allow for 0.002, phone plans 0.004, bus route makes sense 0.029. Low amplitude.
